subject: Clarify confidentiality & publicity clauses — Starlark order form
messages:
From: Ariel Price <aprice@starlark.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@starlark.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2029 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Question on publicity & logo clauses in Order Form

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this week — the pilot kickoff is on track. Legal pulled the draft Order Form and MSA and pushed back on the publicity and confidentiality language. Two specific asks:

1) They want an explicit embargo window for press announcements tied to a joint approval flow (legal@starlark.ai will need to sign off prior to any release). Current draft says "reasonable notice" which is too vague for them.

2) Logo use and customer quote: they need a narrow reference-rights clause (internal-only use is fine for now) and require that any public quote be cleared and stored as evidence (screenshot + dated approval).

Can Redwood provide a one-page summary of the proposed publicity workflow (who approves, SLA for responses, and where approvals are archived)? Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will accept the proposed embargo language: 14 days notice and "mutual approval"?

Attaching Starlark's redline for reference.

Thanks,
Ariel
Product Partnerships | Starlark AI

Attachment: Starlark_OrderForm_Redline.pdf (pdf)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ariel Price <aprice@starlark.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Oct 2029 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Question on publicity & logo clauses in Order Form

Hi Ariel — thank you for the redline and for flagging the evidence requirement.

Short answers:
- Embargo: Redwood is usually fine with a 14-day mutual notice window; we do ask for a short canary period for prod-impacting security disclosures but that's separate.
- Quote/logo approvals: we require a single email thread or signed asset approval to be stored in our contract folder as evidence; I can confirm we accept Starlark's ask for screenshot + dated approval if Legal is comfortable.

Next steps:
1) Looping in Ben (Sales Ops) and Kimberly (Legal) to propose concrete redline language and a one-page approval workflow with archive locations and SLOs.
2) I'll plan to send the draft redline back by EOD Monday so you can circulate internally.

Ben / Kimberly — can you take point on the wording? Pay particular attention to: (a) how we phrase "mutual approval" to avoid ambiguous timelines, and (b) the evidence storage location (we prefer a Drive folder + Doc ID link in the order form).

Best,
Sofia
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Oct 2029 08:44:00 -04:00
Subject: Draft redlines and one-page publicity workflow (internal)

Team — attaching two drafts: (1) redline language for MSA + Order Form that narrows publicity and reference rights, and (2) a one-page workflow we can share with Starlark. Highlights:

- Embargo/Announcement Timing: proposed clause: "Each party shall provide written notice of a planned public announcement no less than fourteen (14) calendar days prior to publication. The receiving party shall provide approval or objection in writing within five (5) business days of receipt. Absent timely objection, approval is deemed granted. Any objection must include commercially reasonable detail and proposed remedies.

- Quote & Logo Use: Redwood may use Customer's name and logo solely for case study or press purposes after Customer's express written approval, which may be provided by e-mail from an authorized representative. Such approval shall be archived in the Parties' shared Drive folder (URL to be included in the Order Form) with a dated approval artifact (e.g., email, signed asset approval).

- Evidence & Auditing: we add a new Order Form field "Publicity Approval Link" where the approving email or asset is pasted; this satisfies their screenshot + dated approval request.

I included alternative language that shortens the approval SLO to 3 business days if Starlark prefers faster turnaround and we can offer a one-time exception for embargo shorter than 14 days for product launch coordination (requires Director approval).

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v3_redline.pdf; OrderForm_STL-001_redlines.docx

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Ariel Price <aprice@starlark.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@starlark.ai
Date: Mon, 08 Oct 2029 11:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines and one-page publicity workflow (internal)

Kimberly / Sofia — this looks great, thanks for the quick turnaround. A couple of small asks from Legal:

1) For the "approval deemed granted" language, they want to convert "Absent timely objection, approval is deemed granted" to "Absent timely objection, approval shall be deemed granted provided that Seller has requested approval with clear context and draft materials." (they want to avoid inadvertent approvals from vague notices).

2) Can we add a short definition for an "authorized representative" (title-level: VP or above, or someone specifically named in the contract appendix)?

If you accept those two tweaks we can sign off and proceed to countersignature. I'll upload a signed Order Form once countersigned.

Thanks again — Ariel
